Service schema places the office 254 km away

Twenty-one Service provider records use coordinates far outside Columbia and include a leading space in the city name.

  • Set the mapped Service.provider.geo fields to the approved GBP pin 33.9739729,-80.9405203.
  • Change addressLocality from “ Columbia” to “Columbia”; keep the valid business and page schema.

Fix order

Repair the broken contact and guide paths, then correct the shared Service provider fields.

  • Website: direct href changes plus two exact redirects; one consolidated schema package.
  • Owner/SEO: confirm the physical pin and CTA provider wording; preserve current approved menus and financing.

Keep approved menus, hours, financing and phone tracking. Speed variation remains diagnostic; no small-image compression task.
